judged_text: packages/types/Calendar.d.ts:171 changes the `Calendar` interface to `createEvent(event: CalendarEvent, credentialId: number): Promise<NewCalendarEventType>`, but `LarkCalendarService.createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` (packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:125), `Office365CalendarService.createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` (packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:72), and `BaseCalendarService.createEvent` (packages/lib/CalendarService.ts, iCal) were not updated to accept/use `credentialId` — TS structural typing for methods permits the mismatched arity to compile, but the "select the calendar matching this credential" mechanism the interface change was meant to guarantee is honored by exactly one implementer (Google) and silently absent everywhere else. Severity: P1. Confidence: 75.
